method: Built-in image_gen, one generation per character using actual FBX model renders

prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: finished ILLOVA game avatar card profile portrait, one character only, portrait aspect ratio 2:3. Input image is a REFERENCE render of the actual in-game 3D model; do not use any previous conversation illustrations. Recreate the SAME recognizable character with extremely faithful identity and the same chibi 3D game-model proportions, very large head, tiny torso, simple stylized facial geometry. Pio: warm ivory-white tousled short hair, dark brown half-lidded gentle eyes, two natural green sprout leaves growing at crown, small calm neutral mouth, white loose long-sleeve top. Preserve the sprout and exact hairstyle. Render as a polished clean soft 3D game promotional portrait, maintaining the model design and colors. Frame head and upper body centered, entire top ornament/ears/hat visible with comfortable top margin, head fills the upper-middle 60 percent, white shirt visible below. Soft natural studio daylight with subtle warm bounce, matte softly textured surfaces. Background is an out-of-focus pale sage ILLOVA garden with gentle circular bokeh, understated and uncluttered. Keep lighting and framing consistent across this portrait series. No text, border, graphic overlay, logos, watermark, extra character, extra accessories, realistic human anatomy, long hair, princess dress, flowers other than those explicitly present on the model, plush toy, or redesigned costume. Preserve recognizable likeness over beautification.
